reason: In apps/web/pages/auth/login.tsx:178-186, when totpEmail is present (populated for Google/SAML 2FA redirects from loginWithTotp in packages/features/auth/lib/next-auth-options.ts:36-37), footerText renders ExternalTotpFooter (apps/web/pages/auth/login.tsx:135-143) instead of TwoFactorFooter. Because the only lost_access button that calls setTwoFactorLostAccess(true) to render <BackupCode /> (apps/web/pages/auth/login.tsx:221) is inside TwoFactorFooter (apps/web/pages/auth/login.tsx:120-131), SAML/Google users never see the backup-code entry point.
